name: My Notes
summary:
My Notes allows you to create text notes to write down ideas, reminders, important information, or any content you need to keep. Each note can include a title and an editable body of text, making it easy to view and update information when needed.

It also allows you to create list-style notes to organize tasks and activities. Each list is made up of independent items that can be added, modified, deleted, reordered, and marked as completed or pending, helping you keep a clear track of your progress.
